purpose: Pins every vendored file so re-vendoring cannot silently change what ships.

files.note: Used to render the s0 PDF certificate so the embedded QR can be decoded offline.

known_advisories.impact: Arbitrary JavaScript execution via a crafted font, through the font evaluator, which reaches eval.
known_advisories.mitigation: The only call site passes isEvalSupported: false, which removes the eval path the advisory depends on. Not upgraded: re-vendoring is a separate, hash-pinned step and this version is pinned in this manifest.
known_advisories.risk_if_mitigation_removed: High. /portal is served from the same origin as the dashboard's destructive API, so script execution in the PDF viewer reaches /api/erase-files.
known_advisories.upgrade_blocked_by: pdf.js 4.x is ESM-only -- it ships .mjs and no UMD bundle. portal.js loads the library as a classic script and reads a `pdfjsLib` global, and the tag carries an SRI integrity attribute. Converting to an ES module import means the library loads asynchronously, so a PDF dropped in the first moments would hit the 'library is loading, try again' path on a verifier -- a real regression for the one job this page has. The migration needs a browser to verify, which this repository's test suite cannot provide (no browser runner, and the existing JS tests exercise verify.js, not the PDF path).

files.note: pdf.js worker; required by worker-src in the portal CSP.
QR decoding. Note: the onlyInvert mode throws in this build; s0 never requests it and isolates every decode attempt.
s0-authored WebCrypto SHA-512/Ed25519 helper so verification needs no network.
